labels.shortDescription: Explains why contact membership does not work with Person Accounts.
labels.value: Person Accounts are enabled, but household membership is still set to use the person's account. In a Person Accounts org the person is an account, so households built that way do not work. Switching to the flexible way of belonging, with one membership record per person, fixes it, and the households you already have are not changed.

labels.shortDescription: Button that switches household membership to the flexible way of belonging.
labels.value: Switch to the Flexible Way of Belonging

labels.shortDescription: Title of the household membership finding.
labels.value: Household membership does not fit Person Accounts

labels.value: Coexistence mode matches your org

labels.shortDescription: Health Check: mode does not match; {0} mode set, {1} mode recommended
labels.value: This org is set to {0}, but what is installed points to {1}. If that is deliberate, leave it. If it is not, switch: households and imports behave differently in each mode.

labels.value: Coexistence mode does not match your org

labels.shortDescription: Health Check: no mode confirmed; {0} mode in use, {1} mode recommended

labels.shortDescription: Explains that no new person is getting a household.
labels.value: Household membership uses membership records, and "create a household automatically" is off, so no person saved from now on gets a household. Nothing fails and nothing is logged while this is true: the people saved in the meantime simply have to be grouped by hand later. Turn automatic households on unless your org deliberately groups people another way.
